taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.source_trace: Read origin decision logic and the actual credential model. Identify a protected response the alternate browser origin should not read, not just an endpoint with headers.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned alternate origin in a browser and controlled account. First verify the legitimate origin can read a private fixture marker, then attempt that read from the alternate origin with the actual cookies/tokens and preflight path. Record whether script can access the protected body; separate server receipt from browser-readable response.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Wildcard access to public data is not a confidentiality violation. A command-line response containing permissive headers does not establish browser credential attachment or readable private bytes.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply exact approved-origin and credential policy across normal/error/redirect responses as required by the feature. Retest allowed origin, denied origin and cache variation behavior where responses vary by Origin.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
